claims: Conan O'Brien is hosting the 98th Academy Awards on March 15, 2026.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony is at the Dolby Theatre.
Conan O'Brien's hosting of the 98th Academy Awards marks his second consecutive year hosting the ceremony at the Dolby Theatre.
Sinners received 16 nominations for the 2026 Oscars.
One Battle After Another received 13 nominations for the 2026 Oscars.
Sinners and One Battle After Another lead the nominations for the 2026 Oscars.
The 95th Academy Awards took place in 2023.
The 95th and earlier Academy Awards ceremonies were often hosted by Jimmy Kimmel.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony is available to stream on Hulu.
